scholarships.title: Organization of American States (OAS) Scholarship at Colorado State University
scholarships.official_source: Colorado State University International Enrollment Center, in partnership with the Organization of American States

eligibility: Be a citizen or permanent resident of an OAS member state (32 economies listed, including Canada and Mexico, excluding the United States)
Be admitted to a degree-seeking, on-campus programme at Colorado State University's Fort Collins campus; only newly admitted students for Fall 2027 are currently considered
Be a transfer undergraduate or a graduate student - new first-year students are not eligible
Not be admitted to the SPUR campus programme, whose students already pay discounted tuition
Not hold a full assistantship awarded by their department
Not be a US citizen or permanent resident, including dual US citizenship or US permanent residence combined with citizenship of a member economy
Graduate applicants: hold a bachelor's degree by the time of application to the scholarship and a GPA above the university's minimum standard
Undergraduate applicants: have completed the first two years of the degree, or hold an Associate's degree, and have a GPA above the university's minimum standard
Possess the language competence needed to study in the language of instruction, and be in good physical and mental health
existing.eligibility_summary: Citizens or permanent residents of any OAS member state except the United States, admitted to a degree-seeking on-campus programme at Colorado State University's Fort Collins campus. Only transfer undergraduate and graduate students are considered (new first-year students and SPUR campus students are not eligible), and students holding a full departmental assistantship are excluded.
benefits: One third off non-resident tuition for all degree-seeking on-campus programmes
coverage: One third off non-resident tuition for all degree-seeking on-campus programmes
requirements: Be admitted to a degree-seeking on-campus programme at the Fort Collins campus for Fall 2027
Complete the brief OAS Scholarship Application on the CSU International Enrollment Center page
Answer the eligibility screening questions (student type, OAS citizenship, dual US citizenship or permanent residence)
Provide name, email, CSU ID, date of birth and mailing address
Write two essay responses of 2-3 paragraphs each: why CSU, and career goals
For the Impact MBA: apply after acceptance into the programme; the scholarship may be combined with other scholarships but is not combinable with a graduate assistantship
documents: CSU identification number (issued when the CSU application account was created)
Evidence of admission to a degree-seeking on-campus programme
Essay responses submitted through the OAS Scholarship Application form
Contact details as requested by the form
existing.english_requirement: Possess the language competence required to undertake studies in the language of the institution in the country of study (published wording; no specific test or score is stated)
application_method: Apply and be admitted to Colorado State University Fort Collins for Fall 2027
Complete the 'OAS Scholarship Application - Colorado State University' form on the CSU International Enrollment Center page
Contact international@colostate.edu for further information on applying
Impact MBA applicants are considered after acceptance into the MBA, which starts annually in August
existing.selection_notes: CSU and the OAS administer selection. A published rule applies to students who qualify for both the OAS Scholarship and the APEC scholarship: they can receive only one award and will receive the higher of the two.
existing.best_fit: Transfer undergraduates and master's, doctoral or Impact MBA students from any OAS member state other than the United States who have been admitted to an on-campus degree programme at Colorado State University's Fort Collins campus and do not hold a full departmental assistantship.
existing.notes:
Students awarded a full assistantship by their department are ineligible, so this tuition reduction is aimed at students without funding from their department. The reduction applies to non-resident tuition only, so admitted US resident students would gain nothing - and US citizens and permanent residents are excluded outright anyway.
Funding period: per academic term as a one-third reduction of non-resident tuition (no absolute amount published)
existing.duration: Programme length follows the degree pursued; the Impact MBA starts annually in August
existing.application_period: Applications are being accepted for newly admitted students entering Fall 2027; the OAS announcement records rolling admission for bachelor's programmes and instructs applicants to contact CSU International for graduate deadlines
existing.deadline_display: No closing date published - the OAS announcement lists 'Rolling admission' for CSU bachelor's programmes and states that graduate admission deadlines vary; applications are being taken for newly admitted Fall 2027 students
existing.program_type: Regional intergovernmental scholarship programme (OAS Partnerships Program for Education and Training, PAEC) with a host university
